name: Associated Press API
tagline: Licensed wire-service API for AP headlines, photos, and full news stories
description: The Associated Press (AP) Content API provides licensed access to AP wire content including headlines, full stories, photos, videos, and metadata. Developers integrate via authenticated HTTPS endpoints under commercial licensing—typically used by publishers, media platforms, and enterprise products that need authoritative newswire content rather than free public news feeds.

auth.details: API key (x-api-key header) issued under AP commercial license; not self-serve free signup—access requires AP Media/Content API agreement

pricing.paid_plans: Commercial licensing only; pricing via AP sales (not published self-serve tiers)

use_cases: search AP wire stories by keyword or topic
fetch full text of a licensed AP news article by item ID
pull latest AP headlines for a news feed or alert system
retrieve AP photos and media metadata for a story
monitor breaking news updates from the AP newswire
